verdict.rationale: Intel documents developer-facing tooling (oneAPI, VTune Profiler, oneDNN, SYCL/DirectX interoperability, PyTorch optimizations) explicitly targeting Core Ultra series 2 CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, showing official optimization guidance and ecosystem investment. Missing for 10: explicit mention of mainstream compiler support (GCC/Clang/MSVC) status, OS-level tier-one confirmation (Windows/Linux kernel support specifics), and independent developer corroboration beyond Intel's own marketing/dev pages.
